title: Jia-Ethan/codex-keysmith
claim: Jia-Ethan/codex-keysmith — Version-independent Codex instruction deployment with dry-run, backups, hook isolation, and recovery.
why_good: Manages and safely deploys Codex instructions/config across versions (dry-run, backups, hook isolation) — real ops hygiene for teams standardizing agents.
value: Team tier for orgs managing agent config at scale; sell safety + reproducibility of agent setups.
risk: Config-management for one vendor's agent; thin, and Codex could bake in versioned config natively.
